g.aria-label: 1. App menu: Projects, Model Manager, Fonts, Queue, Settings and help
2. Project switcher: Switch, rename, export or close projects Ctrl+P / ⌘P
3. Layout preset tabs: Click to switch layouts. A dot means unsaved changes; the arrow opens the preset menu
4. Save as new preset: Save the current arrangement as a preset
5. Invoke controls: Iterations, the Invoke button, and routing: where settings come from and results go
6. Left rail: One icon per panel. Click to show a panel; click the active icon to collapse it
6. Right rail: One icon per panel. Click to show a panel; click the active icon to collapse it
7. Rail menu (…): Add panels to this rail or remove them
8. Left panel: Shows the selected left-rail panel
8. Right panel: Shows the selected right-rail panel
9. Resize handle: Drag to resize the panel; drag past its minimum to collapse it
10. Center panel: The main work area: Preview, Canvas, Gallery, Workflow editor or Image Map
11. Center view menu: Switch the center view, add another, or close the current one. Z swaps in Preview
12. Floating window: Preview and Image Map can float. Drag to move; Dock to panel returns it to its rail
13. Floating panel’s rail slot: Marks where a floating panel came from. Click to dock it again
14. Status bar: Server, queue, gallery, autosave and notifications. Some chips open a bottom panel
